refreshNotes: Final US model year — Volvo announced in March 2026 it would stop US EX30 sales at end of MY2026, with final orders due by March 20, 2026. MY2026 brings the Single Motor Plus to the US (~$38,950 MSRP, 261 mi EPA) and the EX30 Cross Country Twin Motor Performance (227 mi EPA, ~$48,950). Sources: https://www.wardsauto.com/news/volvo-ends-EX30-sales-us-2026/815160/, https://www.motorcarsvolvocars.com/volvo-electric-models.htm
